response.original_title: Come to See Me at Oglala
response.overview: This is a 1987 interview of William Horn Cloud, a renowned traditional Oglala Lakota singer, historian, philosopher, and intellectual who spent his entire life, 85 years, on the Pine Ridge Indian Reservation. I had the good fortune to interview him and his wife which became the basis for this documentary. Original 16mm footage and audiotapes remained unedited until digitized and edited between 2024 and 2026.
response.title: Come to See Me at Oglala
